note: Germany BMF category forecasts for bottom-up macro. Open year pins aggregate Ausgaben/Einnahmen to Monatsbericht Soll (printed at origin; same annual target as production) × asymmetric hist/YTD blend — not a no-authority claim. Edge vs production = execution haircut + later-year smly×macro vs planhc. Dropping Soll (hist_year) clears PRE but OOS ~24 vs ~7.4. Later years: revenue×NGDP, primary smly × T1 sozial×wages β=0.35, interest = debt-book × FA stock × rates. Special funds in plan.json. Leaf Steuerarten audit-only.

macro.source: AMECO/Eurostat nominal GDP YoY; IMF WEO / Eurostat HICP; Eurostat namq D1 wages; Finanzagentur stock + debt-book effective interest rate

drivers.ngdp: nominal GDP YoY (Steuerabschätzung activity base; proxy for wages/profits/VAT)
drivers.cpi: CPI / HICP (audit leaf prior on spend; production later primary CPI β=0)
drivers.wages: Eurostat namq_10_gdp D1 compensation-of-employees YoY (T1 sozial overlay)
drivers.employment: Eurostat namq_10_pe EMP_DC — tried on T1 sozial; PRE clears, OOS does not beat wages
drivers.fa_stock: Finanzagentur total federal debt stock YoY (compounds later-year interest level)

production.open_year_spend: Soll × (0.80 historical Ist/Soll + 0.20 within-year run-rate Ist/(elapsed-share·Soll)), clipped [0.5, 1.5]
production.open_year_revenue: Soll × (0.95 historical Ist/Soll + 0.05 within-year run-rate), clipped [0.5, 1.5]
production.later_primary: smly × (1 + w_sozial · 0.35 · wages_{t−1}); w_sozial ≈ 0.51–0.54 from BMF MB T1 Soziale Sicherung share of primary (ex t1_zins)
production.later_interest: debt-book annual interest[y−1] × interest-carve month-share × (FA total stock YoY)^{Δy} × (1 + 2.0 · rates[y−1]/100)

elasticities_a_priori.note: MoF-style pass-throughs fixed before PRE score. OLS not fit inside PRE — Steuerarten panel starts 2017 (<6 clean years). Production uses aggregate path + T1 overlay; leaf βs are audit.

kst.basis: corporate profits more cyclical than NGDP

t1_sozial.basis: T1 Soziale Sicherung share × D1 wages; β from PRE-clearing grid {0…1}, min OOS

primary_spend.basis: homogeneous CPI prior rejected; T1 share×wages replaces it

zins.basis: coupon calendar × stock path; β on rates from PRE-clearing grid {0,0.5,1,1.5,2}, min OOS

selection_audit.gate: PRE mean MAE ≥5% vs v1, ≤1 worse horizon; among clearers minimize OOS mean MAE

prior_ship.spec: open w_exp=0.20 w_rev=0.05; later br=1.0 NGDP, bp=0.0; interest=coupon×FA-stock×(1+2.0·rates)

shipped.spec: prior + T1 sozial share × wages β=0.35 on later primary
shipped.note: OOS 7.45→7.37; PRE edge 5.2%→6.2%; β=0.35 min OOS on wages grid among PRE clearers

selection_audit.oos_error_dominance: OOS h=12 residual still dominated by later-year primary; T1 sozial×wages cuts it further vs coupon×stock-only
trials_rejected: Equal open YTD weights 0–0.50 × later β grid (972 cells) — best PRE-clearer OOS still behind asymmetric
Leaf month-shares × aggregate Soll — PRE edge 4.2%
Scaled leaf Steuerarten × prior growth renormalized to annual Soll pin — cumulative MAE no-op (annual totals pinned)
Primary later on NGDP — ties β_p=0 CPI case; no further OOS cut
Interest smly×rates bi=1 — dominated on OOS by coupon×FA-stock
BMF Zins leaf as interest path — PRE fails
Special funds — SVIK/SVBw absent in PRE; no PRE-clearing monthly driver
T1 Σ free-level category paths — PRE fails; renorm-to-primary pin = OOS no-op
T1 sozial×NGDP / rest×CPI / wages β=1 — PRE clears; OOS above wages β=0.35

bmf_mb_inventory.T1: Ausgaben nach Aufgabenbereichen — used (sozial share × wages on later primary)
bmf_mb_inventory.T2: Ausgaben nach ökonomischen Arten — used (spend leaves)
bmf_mb_inventory.Sondervermögen: not in Monatsbericht HTML; FA schuldenbericht + plan.json only

categories.source: BMF Monatsbericht — T1 Aufgabenbereiche, T2 ökonomische Arten, T3 Steuerarten
categories.path: data/de/bmf_mb/*.html (parsed live; Dec filled from next-year Ist)
